jobs.title: Senior / Staff Python Engineer - REMOTE
jobs.description:
Senior / Staff Python Engineer

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior / Staff Python Engineer to join a rapidly growing SaaS company that is building next-generation, AI-driven platforms. In this role, you'll combine hands-on coding with technical leadership, mentoring other engineers and shaping the direction of complex, highly scalable systems.

You'll work cross-functionally with Product, Design, and DevOps teams to deliver secure, reliable, and performant features while fostering a culture of innovation and engineering excellence.

What You'll Do

Design and develop high-performance, scalable applications across Backend using Python 
Foster technical growth and continuous learning.
Define and implement system architecture to ensure long-term scalability and maintainability.
Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across applications and infrastructure.
Champion best practices in testing, security, and deployment processes.
Partner closely with Product and DevOps in Agile development cycles to deliver impactful features.
Lead efforts to improve CI/CD pipelines and automation for faster, more reliable releases.
Maintain clear technical documentation to support long-term stability and scalability.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of software development experience
Strong expertise in Python and modern frameworks (Flask, FastAPI, Django, etc.).
Hands-on experience with cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Familiarity with messaging and asynchronous systems such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar.
Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar).
Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, and Git.
Experience implementing testing frameworks, code coverage, and quality standards.
Comfortable working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Bonus: Experience with workflow orchestration tools or observability stacks.

What Success Looks Like

You deliver high-quality, reliable features that scale seamlessly with business growth.
Teams are mentored and aligned on technical best practices and processes.
The platform operates with high reliability, security, and performance.
Systems evolve gracefully to support future demands without compromising stability.

Compensation & Perks

Competitive salary: $170,000 - $200,000, plus potential equity.
Fully remote work environment (US-based).
Significant opportunity to own technical decisions and mentor other engineers.
Collaborative culture built on innovation, growth, and impact.

Benefits

Medical | Blue Cross Blue Shield

Multiple PPO plan options with nationwide coverage
100% in-network preventive care
Comprehensive coverage for doctor visits, prescriptions, and mental health

Dental | Guardian

100% coverage for preventive care
80-90% coverage for basic services
50-60% coverage for major services
Orthodontia benefit up to $2,000

Vision | Guardian VSP

$10 exam copay, $20 materials copay
$150 allowance for frames or contacts every 12 months

Life Insurance | Guardian

Company-paid life insurance of $50,000
for all full-time employees

Voluntary Life Insurance | Guardian

Option to purchase additional coverage for yourself, your spouse, and dependents
Spouse coverage up to 50% of employee amount, child coverage up to $10,000

401(k) Retirement Plan

Employer match of 50% of employee contributions, up to $2,350 per year

Immediate eligibility upon hire and full vesting from day one

Discretionary Paid Time Off (PTO)

Take time as needed to recharge and balance personal responsibilities
No fixed accrual - focused on results and trust

Paid Holidays

annually, including major U.S. holidays and year-end break

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

Amazon has been serving customers since 1995, continually working to make shopping and delivery more convenient, reliable, and seamless. Teams across the company collaborate to improve operations and deliver for customers. At Amazon fulfillment centers, safety is a shared responsibility. Employees follow site safety requirements, wear reflective vests, and have access to hearing protection. The work environment is casual while meeting safety standards; noise and temperatures may vary.

About The Role

Amazon.com Services LLC is seeking a Data Analyst to support the Inventory Control and Quality Assurance (ICQA) department at its Hollister, California location. This role partners with ICQA and Inbound and Outbound operations teams to provide data and analytical support for ACES initiatives, investigate defects, and help maintain compliance with ICQA-related SOX requirements. The analyst will turn operational data into clear, actionable insights that support root cause identification and process improvement. Success requires sound judgment, attention to detail, adaptability, and a focus on measurable business impact.

The schedule is Monday through Friday, DE0T0900. The role may also require flexibility to work weekends, nights, holidays, or overtime based on business needs.

Qualifications

Applicants must have a high school diploma or equivalent, be at least 18 years old, and be authorized to work in the United States. Candidates need at least one year of experience with computers and Microsoft Office, including Excel skills such as VLOOKUPs and pivot tables. Experience writing VBA and using Excel macros is required, as is expertise in SQL, Tableau, and Python. Applicants should also demonstrate experience extracting and analyzing data to identify root causes and support process improvement across a network. One or more years of Microsoft Office experience is required; two or more years is preferred. A data analytics certificate, relevant training, or equivalent experience is preferred.

This position involves the physical demands of fulfillment center work. Employees may need to lift up to 49 pounds, stand or walk for shifts of up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach, with or without reasonable accommodation. Work may involve secure mezzanines up to 40 feet high or powered equipment. Candidates must be able to work 40 hours per week and additional overtime as required.

Responsibilities

Develop data collection processes and data management systems, and maintain data integrity with a target of zero errors. Design queries, compile information, and create reports using Microsoft Access and Excel. Chart and graph data for reporting, conduct in-depth research into defect trends, and perform data collection, entry, mining, and problem solving as needed. Present findings in clear, standardized reports that are accessible to operational stakeholders. Help leadership interpret data trends and use insights to guide decisions and process improvements. Respond to priority requests from senior leadership and provide backup support for ICQA Process Assistant duties.

Benefits

The starting hourly pay range is $27.25 to $29.25, including the highest available shift differential; actual pay depends on shift selection and location. Additional earnings may include shift differentials and overtime. Benefits beginning on the first day of employment include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company match, an Employee Assistance Program, mental health support, a medical advice line, holiday and overtime pay, and an employee discount. Relocation assistance is not provided.

Equal Opportunity

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Amazon’s inclusive culture supports employees in doing their best work. Applicants who need an accommodation or adjustment during the application or hiring process, including interviews or onboarding, may contact their Recruiting Partner for assistance. For applicants in Los Angeles County, the company will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance. Criminal history may be relevant to certain job duties, consistent with applicable law.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Associate 1
jobs.description:
Summary

Please note: Multiple positions are available across different departments and shifts. We will make every effort to accommodate shift requests when possible, but departments will be assigned based on business needs.

The Manufacturing Associate I is responsible for safely operating a variety of manufacturing equipment to produce super-abrasive and related products while meeting quality, productivity, and safety standards. This role performs equipment operation, product assembly, inspection, machine setup, basic troubleshooting, and preventative maintenance in accordance with documented work instructions. The position supports Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives, maintains a clean and organized work area, collaborates with team members to promote safe operations, and ensures product and process quality by identifying and communicating production or quality concerns.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Participate in team initiatives to identify and resolve safety issues.
Participation in developing LEAN solutions throughout manufacturing.
Operate manufacturing equipment safely to produce super abrasives and related products within specified work area. Specifically:

Operate automated machinery, presses, lathes, mills, furnaces, wire EDMs, and robotic equipment.
Operate chemical processing equipment and handle hazardous chemicals.
Perform hand assemblies of product, blends, sieved material, and other as required.
Operate and interpret results from measuring tools, gauges, scales, microscopes, go/no go gauges, and visual standards.
Perform minor tooling changes, setup and troubleshooting on production equipment. Assist area experts in completing higher difficulty tooling setup, changeovers and troubleshooting.
Perform basic preventative maintenance tasks including lubrication, filter changes, equipment cleanliness, and other as necessary.
Perform housekeeping duties in assigned work area.
Partner with team members to ensure the safe and responsible operation of assigned equipment
Adhere to documented work instructions: PPF, POCI, EOI, JSA, assembly prints, and other as needed.
Assure product and process quality measures are maintained. Communicate quality concerns to relevant technical support personnel.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education And/or Work Experience

High school diploma or equivalent preferred.
Demonstrated interpersonal and teamwork skills.
Solid work experience in light industrial, manufacturing or military service
Ability to use and learn production management tools including: LEAN, material management systems, and maintenance of accurate throughput and quality records.

Technical Skills/Physical Requirements

Standing, walking, bending, lifting, reaching, pulling, pushing for majority of work day.
Lifting up-to 40 lbs.
Manual Dexterity and fine motor skills to handle and manipulate small items
Ability to follow moderately complex written instructions
Basic computer and keyboard skills
